spans.s: लक्ष्मणात् पूर्वःbharataHlakSmaNAtpUrvaHsent.BharataHisolderthanLakshmanaHभरती bharatIf. female descendant of Bharata [ ti ]प्राग्ज्योतिष prAgjyotiSan. country bordering north-east border of Bharat [ region covering a part of Assam state and some of present day Mayanmar ]
भाट्ट bhATTa n. work of Bhatta
संस्कृतात् ऋते गीतायाः मूलार्थः न ज्ञायते saMskRtAt Rte gItAyAH mUlArthaH na jJAyatesent. without Sanskrit one cannot know the meaning of the Bhagavad Gita
